source='''def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    color = min((v for v in counts if v != 0), key=lambda v: counts[v])
    points = [(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v == color]
    rmin=min(r for r,c in points); cmin=min(c for r,c in points)
    shape=[(r-rmin,c-cmin) for r,c in points]
    variants=set()
    for k in range(4):
        for flip in (False,True):
            p=[]
            for r,c in shape:
                if flip: c=-c
                for _ in range(k): r,c=c,-r
                p.append((r,c))
            mr=min(r for r,c in p); mc=min(c for r,c in p)
            variants.add(tuple(sorted((r-mr,c-mc) for r,c in p)))
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); marked=set()
    for sh in variants:
        hh=max(r for r,c in sh)+1; ww=max(c for r,c in sh)+1
        for r0 in range(h-hh+1):
            for c0 in range(w-ww+1):
                cells={(r0+r,c0+c) for r,c in sh}
                if all(grid[r][c]==0 or grid[r][c]==color for r,c in cells):
                    marked.update((r,c) for r,c in cells if grid[r][c]==0)
    return [[color if (r,c) in marked else v for c,v in enumerate(row)] for r,row in enumerate(grid)]
'''
